result.title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
result.summary: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. Across 5 models and 12 benchmarks, prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation in $55$ of $57$ valid cells, with the strongest effect on open-ended QA. We derive an Adaptive-K rule that uses a four-path pilot to select $K^*$, retaining $96$--$103\%$ of MV@$K{=}32$ accuracy across Math, QA, and NLU.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作把多路径 LLM 推理（如 self-consistency 的多数投票）形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，用路径正确性的成对相关性刻画投票有效样本量的上限，并用 GLS 分析说明可交换性下最优对称线性组合为均匀权重；在 5 个模型、12 个基准上验证提示模板多样性可降低路径相关性，并提出用四条路径试点选择 K* 的 Adaptive-K 规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有效样本量上限」「路径正确性相关性」与对 latent 表示做最优线性组合的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态/轨迹的多样性、合并权重与何时停止采样（STOP）提供可核查的理论线索。
